S17.canonical_sql: SELECT retention_difficulty_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(job_health_score), 2) AS avg_health, ROUND(AVG(avg_career_development_score), 2) AS avg_dev, ROUND(AVG(high_performer_percentage * career_growth_potential_percentage), 5) AS avg_quality, ROUND(AVG(current_employees_count * 1.0 / active_positions_count), 3) AS avg_saturation, ROUND(AVG(avg_weekly_hours), 2) AS avg_hours, ROUND(SUM(is_work_shift_required) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 3) AS shift_ratio FROM workday__job_overview WHERE job_value_tier IN ('Tier 1', 'Tier 2') AND talent_competition_level IN ('High', 'Very High') GROUP BY retention_difficulty_level ORDER BY cnt DESC
